wan_to_lan_dnat.description: WAN-side client sends traffic to Router WAN IP. Router DNAT forwards traffic to LAN iperf3 server.

lan_to_wan_dnat_reply.description: This is iperf3 reverse mode over the same DNAT connection. The LAN iperf3 server sends reply-direction traffic back to the WAN-side client. This is not a standard outbound LAN-to-WAN SRCNAT test.
lan_to_wan_dnat_reply.traffic_direction: LAN server to WAN client over iperf3 reverse mode

manual_prerequisite: Start iperf3 server on LAN-side PC: iperf3 -s
Configure RouterOS dst-nat TCP/5201 from WAN interface to LAN server IP
Configure RouterOS firewall forward allow TCP/5201 to LAN server IP
Confirm router WAN IP before running iperf3
